errors.evidence: The description states that for the mmsd model, the accuracy decreases to about 80.2% at a Prompt Depth of 11. However, the plot shows this value is closer to 80.1%, which is visually lower than the data point at Prompt Depth 5 (which is approx 80.2%).

errors.text_span: rising to approximately 77.5% at a Prompt Depth of 7 and 9
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies that the accuracy for the mmsd2 model is the same (77.5%) at Prompt Depths 7 and 9. The plot clearly shows that the accuracy increases from approximately 77.5% at depth 7 to a slightly higher peak value (around 77.6%) at depth 9. This flattens the peak and misrepresents the trend.
